mapper.select: SELECT point_policy_sq AS pointPolicySq, attendance_point AS attendancePoint, streak_point AS streakPoint, event_point AS eventPoint, auto_payment_yn AS autoPaymentYn, duplicate_block_yn AS duplicateBlockYn, manual_adjust_yn AS manualAdjustYn, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt, DATE_FORMAT(mod_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS modDt FROM TBL_POINT_POLICY_M ORDER BY point_policy_sq DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_POINT_POLICY_M SET attendance_point = #{attendancePoint}, streak_point = #{streakPoint}, event_point = #{eventPoint}, auto_payment_yn = #{autoPaymentYn}, duplicate_block_yn = #{duplicateBlockYn}, manual_adjust_yn = #{manualAdjustYn}, mod_dt = NOW() WHERE point_policy_sq = ( SELECT point_policy_sq FROM ( SELECT point_policy_sq FROM TBL_POINT_POLICY_M ORDER BY point_policy_sq DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS latest_policy )
